messages:
emma: Just posted the incident synthesis + action plan -> https://redwood.internal/rca/1940001111 :link: 

TL;DR: cache eviction during a model rollout caused ~30% client errors for 12m. Root cause: cache key shard mismatch + aggressive eviction policy during concurrent rollouts. Impacted: Hosted API routes in us-west-2.

Highlights and immediate remediation performed: rollback to previous model variant, temporary cache warming job started, autoscale policy reverted. Full details + timeline in the doc. Please read and ack.

Action owners summarized below — please comment if you need to reassign. Need acknowledgements by EOD.

raj: Thanks emma. Quick Q — what's the priority between autoscale rule fix and the cache warmup job?

emma: Autoscale rule fix is P0 (Dedicated SLA risk). Cache warmup is P1 (latency/cost). Both in the plan; autoscale patch goes first.

leo: I can own the autoscale patch. Will open PR + test plan.

raj: I'll pick up the cache warmup job + integration test harness. Assigning now.

sophia: Scheduling checkpoint for Wednesday 10:00 PST with infra + runtime. Sending calendar invite.

ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: follow-ups created: INC-4721 (autoscale rule), INC-4722 (cache-warmup), INC-4723 (canary gate). RCA doc linked.

emma: Action items (short):
```
- INC-4721: autoscale rule fix -> owner: leo -> PR + staging tests (due: 48h)
- INC-4722: cache warmup job + integration test -> owner: raj -> runbook + cron (due: 72h)
- INC-4723: add canary gate to rollout controller -> owner: raj/leo -> design doc (due: 1 week)
- INC-4724: alert sensitivity tuning for cache eviction -> owner: sophia -> metrics + thresholds (due: 72h)
```

raj: One more ask: let's add a short runtime check that fails fast if shard mismatch detected. I'll draft a small snippet.

leo: +1. I'll add the runtime guard into the autoscale PR so QA can exercise it.

sophia: Ack from infra. Will update the runbook and prod playbook once PRs merge.

emma: :white_check_mark: Thank you all. We'll run a follow-up async check-in in 3 days and review canary plan in next ops sync. If you haven't acked in the thread, please do so now.

leo: Ack.

raj: Ack.

sophia: Ack.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up checkpoint at 1940250000 (Wed 10:00 PST) created.
